prompt:
Our agent plugin deployment pipeline keeps failing in production because some plugin definition files are broken and operations run without any safety net. Before our next release, I need you to do two things:

1. Go through all the plugin files in the `plugins/` directory and fix any that are broken or incomplete so they can be properly registered by the system. The fix must be applied directly to the files — not just reported.

2. Process the operations listed in `ops/scheduled/operations_manifest.json`. Some of those operations will fail or hang — make sure each one runs with proper protection. For every failure you encounter, record what went wrong and what recovery action was taken.

All issues found and recovery actions taken must be documented in a file called `ERRORS.md`. This file must be placed in the standard audit location our platform already uses for this kind of report.
